lines.zh: 我在水里慢慢摆尾，很稳。
lines.en: I sweep my tail slowly and steadily.

lines.zh: 我沿着池底游，影子很淡。
lines.en: I swim along the pond floor, my shadow faint.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根水草，再往前。
lines.en: I round a reed and go on.
I glide past the fallen petals.

lines.zh: 我游到浅一点的地方，停下。
lines.en: I swim into the shallows and stop.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯，水面起了圈。
lines.en: I turn, and rings spread on the surface.
I swim toward the far side of the pond.
I pass slowly between the stones.
When I sweep my tail, the water barely stirs.
I swim through a reflection, and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我浮上去一点，又沉下来。
lines.en: I rise a little, then sink back.

lines.zh: 我慢得几乎看不出在动。
lines.en: I move so slowly you can hardly tell.
I stop at the pond's center and hold.
My fins fan slowly.

lines.zh: 水面上有花瓣，我不去碰。
lines.en: Petals on the surface; I leave them be.
I watch the bank from the water.
The water is clear enough to show me.

lines.zh: 我把自己稳在水草之间。
lines.en: I settle myself among the reeds.
I look up, mouth opening and closing.
This stretch of water is quiet.
I hear footsteps on the bank.
I wait for the surface to flatten.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在池底的石上。
lines.en: My shadow lies on the stone below.
I turn slightly on my side.
I'm old, and I swim slowly.
A few more petals drift down.
You crouch at the bank; I can see you.
You've cast your shadow into the water.
I raise my head and come to the surface.
Coming in? The water's fine.
I'm not afraid of you; I'm grown.
That thing in your hand is bright.
Don't put your hand in too quickly.

lines.zh: 我在这一池水里住了很久。
lines.en: I've lived in this pond a long time.
There are petals by your feet.
I float, my mouth at the surface.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我游开一点。
lines.en: A step from you, a little swim from me.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上看了好一会儿。
lines.en: You've been watching from the bank a while.
I turn, and my scales flash.
Don't try to scoop me up.
The water's mine; the bank is yours.
This pond belongs to me alone.
What are you laughing at? I don't follow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地沉下去，又上来。
lines.en: I sink slowly, then rise again.

lines.zh: 我沉下去一点，稳住身子。
lines.en: I sink a little and steady myself.

lines.zh: 我的鳍贴着身子收紧了。
lines.en: My fins pull in tight against me.
I sweep away, barely splashing.

lines.zh: 这一下打在水里，声音很闷。
lines.en: That landed in the water, muffled.
I swim one circuit of the pond.
I press close to the reeds.
There's a white mark on my scales.
I make no sound; the water moves for me.
I surface for a breath.
I'm still in this pond.
Something has fallen onto the surface.

lines.zh: 那点动静引起了我的注意。
lines.en: That small stir caught my attention.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向游了一点。
lines.en: I swim a little that way.
What's that in your hand?

lines.zh: 我浮上来，看清楚了再说。
lines.en: I'll come up and look before deciding.
The ripples reach all the way to me.

lines.zh: 我绕着那点吃食游了半圈。
lines.en: I swim half a circle around the food.
I'm in no hurry; I only look.
Put it down on the water's surface.
That glimmer is lovely in the water.
You step into the water; I make room.
My side brushes your ankle.
One tail sweep, and water splashes.
You step back; only then do I near the bank.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，水波散开。
lines.en: We touch, and the ripples spread.

lines.zh: 我潜下去，从你另一边上来。
lines.en: I dive and surface on your other side.
You stand in the water; I circle around.
I don't bump you; I only pass.
My scales graze your boot.
We've muddied the water a little.

lines.zh: 另一条在池子的另一边。
lines.en: Another is on the far side of the pond.
She's a size smaller, and quicker.
We swim side by side around the pond.

lines.zh: 她把水草拨开，让我过去。
lines.en: She parts the reeds for me.
We rise to the surface together.
There's a white edge on her fin.
We glide along the pond floor, slowly.
When she turns, I turn.
Two fish, one still pond.
Water needs no words.

lines.zh: 我顶起一片落花，又放开。
lines.en: I nudge a petal up, then let it go.
I push a pebble straight on the bottom.
I touch the reeds with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根细枝，放回去。
lines.en: I take a twig and put it back.

lines.zh: 我把落进水的果子推到岸边。
lines.en: I push the fallen fruit to the bank.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下你掉的东西。
lines.en: I nudge what you dropped.
I part the leaves on the surface.
I take up a bright pebble.

lines.zh: 我把它推到水草底下藏着。
lines.en: I push it under the reeds to hide.
I touch your reflection.
Something is coming along the bank.
The ripples tell me the direction.
I rise a little and look that way.
I swim that way.
This pond is my place.
Its feet are already at the water.
I don't like that kind of noise.
I slowly turn about.
I rise to see more clearly.
I remember it splashed just now.
I begin to move that way.
I wait for it to come closer.
I know this water well.
I raise my dorsal fin.
I slip out from between the reeds.
It's standing in the water; perfect.
I watch it from under the water.

lines.zh: 它的脚一挪，水就报了信。
lines.en: One shift of its foot, and the water tells me.
I circle behind it.
I turn my body sideways.
I'm very close to its feet.
It hasn't looked into the water yet.

lines.zh: 我把水面弄出一点波纹。
lines.en: I raise a small ripple.
I sink slowly beneath it.
It steps back; I follow.
I wait for it to look down.
I move along the bottom toward it.

lines.zh: 这一池水没有别的声音。
lines.en: No other sound in this pond.
I fold my tailfin and sink.
It stepped on my stone.
I circle its feet twice.
It's panicking; the water clouds.
I haven't shown my head once.
It looks for the bank; it's far.
I whip my tail into its leg.
I ram up from the bottom.
I butt its knee.
I churn the water until it's blind.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的裤脚，往下拉。
lines.en: I bite its trouser hem and pull down.
It retreats; water flies.

lines.zh: 我贴着它的脚踝蹭过去。
lines.en: I slide past its ankle.
That was heavy; the water thudded.
I drive it toward the deep.

lines.zh: 它站不稳，我绕到另一侧。
lines.en: It can't keep footing; I swing to the far side.

lines.zh: 我又撞了一下它的膝弯。
lines.en: I butt the back of its knee again.
My tail throws up a sheet of water.
Its feet sink into the pond mud.
I withdraw, and the surface settles.
I barely used any force.
This pond works for me.

lines.zh: 水面破了一下，我浮上来。
lines.en: The surface breaks; I rise.
I come out from the reeds.
The pond is very still today.
Petals cover the surface.
I make one slow circuit.

lines.zh: 我在花木林的水里出生。
lines.en: I was born in the blossom wood's water.
My fins spread for the first time.
No one has come to the bank yet.

lines.zh: 水底的石头上有一层苔。
lines.en: The stones below are furred with moss.
I look up at the blossoms.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别的东西靠近。
lines.en: Nothing else comes near this place.
I settle myself at the pond's center.
The water is cool; just right.

lines.zh: 我呼吸时，水面动了一下。
lines.en: When I breathe, the surface stirs.
A petal falls; I move aside.
My shadow spreads on the pond floor.
I begin patrolling this water.
A bird calls in the distance.

lines.zh: 水面烫了一下，我往深处沉。
lines.en: The surface heats; I sink deeper.
I'm knocked out of the water and fall back.
Even in water I can't draw air.

lines.zh: 爆炸把池水掀开，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast lifts the pond; I roll over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水，钉进我的鳞里。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the water and pins my scales.

lines.zh: 光穿过水，照得我不敢动。
lines.en: Light pierces the water; I dare not move.

lines.zh: 池子里能吃的越来越少。
lines.en: There's less and less to eat in the pond.
Lightning enters the water, and I go numb.

lines.zh: 没有水，我连鳍都张不开。
lines.en: No water; I can't even spread my fins.
